node.title: PMA full-petal band/root composition
node.statement: For one carried maximal source, the G1 chart count is the total petal count M, while t counts petals touched by one full-petal codeword. On-band, t is M-1 or M, so equality is false in general. Composing the top-band payment with the E=0 root-pinning aggregate pays every full-petal source with M<=3 and the all-touched M=4 stratum. A remaining full-petal family must have M>=4, d<ell(M-2), t<2M-4, and unbounded root excess.
